# Licence of this stub

The published `servo-script-0.7.0` package on crates.io ships no licence file; its
`Cargo.toml` declares `MPL-2.0`. Upstream: https://github.com/servo/servo.

This stub holds none of the crate's code. It copies only the package's name,
version, licence expression, `[lib]` name and the names of its features, so
Cargo can resolve the lockfile. See `third_party/ot61-browser/VENDORED.md`,
"The stubs for other platforms".
